caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest, presented in a three-quarter perspective view, with the front and right sides visible. The chest is brown in color, with variations in shading to indicate the wood grain and texture. The lid is slightly angled, giving it a sense of depth. On the front face of the chest, there is a centrally located, gold-colored, hexagonal plaque with indented corners, engraved with the text "HA. HA. HERBSTIN 1781." Beneath the main compartment are two horizontal rectangular panels, each with a small round knob or keyhole in the center, suggesting they are drawers. The base of the chest is wider, with a decorative trim and four short legs at the corners, each with a simple inward curve. The chest is outlined with a thin black line, framed by a larger square pencil border on a beige background. The artist's signature is present in the lower right-hand corner.
title: Chest
